name: Scott's Ferry General Store & Campground
note: Family-owned campground on the Chipola River at the SR-71 bridge south of Blountstown, behind a general store and deli. 15 grass RV sites with 30-amp electric and water ($40/night, 2026), dump station, bathhouse, tent sites and rustic cabins; boat launch, dock, and canoe/kayak rentals. Booked online through Park With Us. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: scottsferrycamp.com live (phone, hours, store, 'RV sites and rustic cabins') linking online booking at parkwith.us/camps/scotts-ferry-campground; operator site map shows 15 RV sites + dump station; RV site $40/night with 30A + water read from the booking engine by AWH 2026-10-02; Google 4.4 over 127 (quality signal for an RV-Life-unrated park); satellite shows trailer-length rigs parked on the open grass sites
waterfront_evidence: satellite (Esri, 260 m frame) at 30.2884,-85.1445: RV sites on open grass ~55 m east of the Chipola River, with the campground loop road and a continuous strip of bank trees between them and the water; only the dock and boat launch reach the river (operator map agrees) - not waterfront; riverview candidate if a leaf-on sightline is ever confirmed
